title: Explore non-local Hardness Magnification / Hirahara non-black-box reductions for MKtP
summary: Analyzed CHOPRS (STOC 2020) Locality Barrier and Hirahara's non-black-box MKtP reductions; certified exact n=3 (256-function) DAG MCSP[s] distribution, depth<=3 local oracle decision trees, Razborov-Rudich density split, parameter-window collapse (beta<eps/c->0), and the Non-Uniform Code-Size Paradox (|M|+advice < N < |C|=N^(1+eps) << |O_m|=2^m).
